products.name: Hydro Flask 32 oz Wide Mouth with Flex Straw Cap
products.description:
Size: 32 oz (946 ml) · 3.8 in × 10.35 in · 1.05 lb
Insulated stainless-steel water bottle with a leakproof squeezable straw cap that opens one-handed. Double-wall vacuum insulation keeps drinks cold for up to 24 hours. Wide mouth fits ice cubes.
How to use: For cold drinks only with the straw cap. Dishwasher safe. Do not microwave or freeze.

products.name: Stanley Quencher H2.0 FlowState Tumbler, 40 oz
products.description:
Size: 40 oz (1.18 L) · 3.1 in base · 1.18 lb
Insulated tumbler made of 90% recycled stainless steel with a 3-position FlowState lid (straw, wide mouth, full cover), comfort-grip handle and a base that fits most car cup holders.
How to use: Dishwasher safe. Not fully leakproof - keep upright in a bag.

products.name: Harbinger Padded Cotton Lifting Straps
products.description:
Size: 1 pair · 21.5 in long
Cotton lifting straps with a NeoTek wrist pad, extra 1.5 in width for more grip contact and merrowed ends that resist fraying. Take the load off your grip on deadlifts, rows and pulls.
How to use: Loop the strap around your wrist, wrap it around the bar and tighten. Clean with water and mild detergent. 90-day warranty.

products.name: Harbinger Figure 8 Padded Lifting Straps
products.description:
Size: 1 pair · figure-8 padded loops
Double-loop figure-8 straps with wrist padding: slide your hands in, wrap the bar and lift. Quick setup and a secure hold for heavy deadlifts and shrugs. No quick-release, so use with care.
How to use: Slip both hands through the loops, drop the strap under the bar and lift. Sizing: SM/MD.

products.name: Harbinger 6-inch Padded Leather Belt 2.0
products.description:
Size: 6 in wide · sizes S-XXL
Genuine split-leather weightlifting belt with interior foam padding, a tapered edge for range of motion on Olympic lifts, a dual-prong steel roller buckle and double stitching. Supports the lower back on heavy squats and deadlifts.
How to use: Wear around your waist at the belly-button level and brace into the belt on heavy sets. Measure your waist and use the size chart on the page.

products.name: Harbinger Pro WristWrap Weightlifting Gloves
products.description:
Size: 1 pair · half-finger · sizes S-XL
Weightlifting gloves with an integrated wrist wrap, foam-padded palms and abrasion-resistant leather. Protect the palms and keep the wrists aligned during lifts.
How to use: Pick the size using the size chart. Wrap the strap around the wrist and fasten. Air-dry after use.

products.name: Optimum Nutrition Gold Standard 100% Whey, 2 lb
products.description:
Volume: 907 g (2 lb) · ~29 servings × 31 g
Effect on muscle mass: Not an anabolic agent. A classic whey protein with 24 g of protein and 5.5 g of BCAAs per serving, primarily from whey protein isolate. Supports muscle recovery and helps cover daily protein needs, which indirectly supports muscle growth when combined with training.
How to use: Mix 1 scoop (31 g) with 200–250 ml of water or milk. Take after training or between meals, 1–2 servings per day.

products.name: Optimum Nutrition Gold Standard 100% Casein, 2 lb
products.description:
Volume: 909 g (2 lb) · 25 servings × 34 g
Effect on muscle mass: Not an anabolic agent. Slow-digesting micellar casein with 24 g of protein per serving. Associated with overnight recovery and reduced muscle breakdown during long gaps between meals.
How to use: Mix 1 scoop (34 g) with 250–350 ml of cold water or milk, 30–60 minutes before bed.

products.name: Optimum Nutrition Micronized Creatine Powder, 300 g
products.description:
Volume: 300 g · 60 servings × 5 g
Effect on muscle mass: Not an anabolic agent. Pure micronized creatine monohydrate, 5 g per serving, banned-substance tested. Associated with greater strength, power output and training volume, which indirectly supports muscle growth.
How to use: Mix 1 rounded teaspoon (5 g) with water, juice or a shake once a day, any time. Drink plenty of water.

products.name: Optimum Nutrition Glutamine Powder
products.description:
Volume: 300 g · 60 servings × 5 g
Effect on muscle mass: Not an anabolic agent. Unflavored L-glutamine, 5 g per serving. Associated with post-workout recovery and gut health under heavy training load.
How to use: Mix 5 g (1 teaspoon) with water or a shake, 1–2 times a day, ideally after training and before bed.

products.name: Optimum Nutrition Serious Mass, 6 lb
products.description:
Volume: 2.72 kg (6 lb) · 8 servings × 340 g
Effect on muscle mass: Not an anabolic agent. A high-calorie weight gainer: ~1,250 kcal, 50 g of protein, 250+ g of carbs and creatine per serving. For people who struggle to eat enough. Supports weight gain when combined with training.
How to use: Mix 1 serving (340 g, about 2 heaping scoops) with water or milk in a blender for 30–45 seconds. New users start with half a serving for the first week.

products.name: Cellucor C4 Original Pre-Workout, 30 servings
products.description:
Volume: 30 servings × 1 scoop (~6.5 g)
Effect on muscle mass: Not an anabolic agent. A stimulant pre-workout with caffeine and CarnoSyn beta-alanine. Associated with energy, focus and training intensity.
How to use: Mix 1 level scoop with about 180 ml (6 fl oz) of water 20–30 minutes before training. Do not exceed 1 serving per day. Not for those sensitive to caffeine.

products.name: NOW Sports L-Carnitine Liquid 1000 mg, 16 fl oz
products.description:
Volume: 473 ml (16 fl oz) · 31 servings × 15 ml
Effect on muscle mass: Not an anabolic agent. 1,000 mg of Carnipure L-carnitine plus vitamin B6 per tablespoon. Associated with fat metabolism and energy production. Does not burn fat on its own, works with diet and training.
How to use: Take 1 tablespoon (15 ml) daily, 20–30 minutes before training or in the morning.

products.name: NOW Vitamin C-1000 with Rose Hips, 100 tablets
products.description:
Quantity: 100 tablets · 100 servings × 1 tablet
1,000 mg of vitamin C with 25 mg of rose hips per tablet. Supports normal immune function and collagen formation. Vegan, non-GMO.
How to use: Take 1 tablet daily with a meal and a glass of water.

products.name: NOW Vitamin D-3 5,000 IU, 120 softgels
products.description:
Quantity: 120 softgels · 120 servings × 1 softgel
Vitamin D3 (125 mcg / 5,000 IU) in extra virgin olive oil. Supports bone and muscle function and normal immune function. Useful in winter or with little sun exposure.
How to use: Take 1 softgel daily with a meal containing fat. Consult a doctor if pregnant, nursing or on medication.

products.name: NOW Magnesium Glycinate, 180 tablets
products.description:
Quantity: 180 tablets · 90 servings × 2 tablets
Albion magnesium bisglycinate, 200 mg of elemental magnesium per 2 tablets. Gentle, highly absorbable. Supports muscles, the nervous system and normal sleep.
How to use: Take 2 tablets daily, preferably in the evening with food.

products.name: Nordic Naturals Ultimate Omega, 120 soft gels
products.description:
Volume: 120 soft gels · 60 servings × 2 soft gels
1,280 mg of EPA and DHA omega-3 per serving (2 soft gels), lemon flavor. Supports heart, brain and joint health.
How to use: Take 2 soft gels daily with food.

products.name: Sports Research Multi Collagen Complex, 90 capsules
products.description:
Quantity: 90 capsules · 30 servings × 3 capsules
Five types of collagen (I, II, III, V, X) with hyaluronic acid and vitamin C, 1,600 mg per serving. Associated with skin, hair, nails and joint comfort. Contains egg and fish.
How to use: Take 3 capsules daily with or without food. Results typically need 8–12 weeks of consistent use.

products.name: Optimum Nutrition Opti-Men, 90 tablets
products.description:
Quantity: 90 tablets · 30 servings × 3 tablets
A multivitamin for active men with 25 vitamins and minerals, free-form amino acids and antioxidant vitamins A, C and E. Covers common gaps in the diet and supports energy metabolism.
How to use: Take 3 tablets with food, 1 serving per day.

products.name: NOW Zinc 50 mg, 100 tablets
products.description:
Quantity: 100 tablets · 100 servings × 1 tablet
50 mg of elemental zinc (as zinc gluconate) per tablet. Supports immune function, skin and normal testosterone levels. Not for long-term use.
How to use: Take 1 tablet daily with a meal. Not for use during pregnancy or nursing.

products.name: NOW Vitamin B-50, 100 veg capsules
products.description:
Quantity: 100 veg capsules · 100 servings × 1 capsule
A balanced B-complex with 50 mg of the main B vitamins per capsule. Supports energy metabolism and the nervous system.
How to use: Take 1 capsule daily with a meal.

products.name: NOW Ashwagandha Extract 450 mg, 90 veg capsules
products.description:
Quantity: 90 veg capsules · 90 servings × 1 capsule
Standardized ashwagandha root extract, 450 mg per capsule. Associated with stress resilience, calmer mood and better sleep quality.
How to use: Take 1 capsule 2–3 times daily with food. Not recommended during pregnancy.

products.name: MORBIDIUS CAFFEINE SACHET
products.description:
Volume: 200 mg caffeine per serving (sachet)
Effect on muscle mass: Not an anabolic agent. A high-purity caffeine supplement used as a central nervous system stimulant. Does not build muscle directly, but may indirectly support training performance, endurance, focus, and fat oxidation. Commonly used during cutting phases or pre-workout to enhance intensity and calorie expenditure.
